headline: Goodbye, Hello…
summary: Aabha Indian Cuisine is under new ownership and undergoing renovation for rebranding. Subash Subba Chongbang, who also owns the popular Namaste India Bistro in Monterey, took over the Carmel Barnyard location at the beginning of October.
